I say this one a lot because people keep getting it twisted...

Your job pays you. That's the deal, and it's a fair one. But the thing they're paying for? The way you think, the problems you solve, the reason people at work come to YOU... that was yours before the title and it'll be yours after.

So be real with me. What's the thing people come to you for that has nothing to do with your job title?
